<DESCRIPTION>SIXTH AMENDMENT TO DISTRIBUTION AND SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH VENTURE MEDICAL, LLC DATED JANUARY 1, 2026

<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: right"><B>Exhibit 10.16</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; color: red">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; color: red">Please be advised that certain identified information
has been excluded in this Exhibit because it is the type of information that the registrant treats as private or confidential and is (i)
not material and (ii) would be competitively harmful if publicly disclosed. Information that has been redacted/omitted is symbolized by
&ldquo;[***]&rdquo;.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-indent: 59.85pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">SIXTH AMENDMENT TO</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">DISTRIBUTION
AND SERVICES AGREEMENT</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-indent: 59.85pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 35.95pt">This Sixth
Amendment to the Distribution and Services Agreement (this &ldquo;<B>Sixth Amendment</B>&rdquo;) is made by and between BioStem Technologies,
Inc., a Florida corporation (&ldquo;<B>Company</B>&rdquo;) and Venture Medical, LLC, a Montana limited liability company (&ldquo;<B>Distributor</B>&rdquo;),
and is effective as of January 1, 2026 (the &ldquo;<B>Sixth Amendment Effective Date</B>&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 35.95pt"><B>WHEREAS</B>,
the Parties entered into a Distribution and Services Agreement effective September 8, 2023 (the &ldquo;<B>Original Agreement</B>&rdquo;),
as previously amended by the First Amendment to the Distribution and Services Agreement dated March 1, 2024 (the &ldquo;<B>First Amendment</B>&rdquo;),
the Amended and Restated Second Amendment to the Distribution and Services Agreement dated October 8, 2024 (the &ldquo;<B>Amended and
Restated Second Amendment</B>&rdquo;), the Third Amendment to the Distribution and Services Agreement dated June 1, 2025 (the &ldquo;<B>Third
Amendment</B>&rdquo;), the Fourth Amendment to the Distribution and Services Agreement dated July 17, 2025 (the &ldquo;<B>Fourth Amendment</B>&rdquo;),
and the Fifth Amendment to the Distribution and Services Agreement dated December 17. 2025 (&ldquo;<B>Fifth Amendment</B>&rdquo;). The
Original Agreement, as amended by the First Amendment, the Amended and Restated Second Amendment, the Third Amendment, the Fourth Amendment
and Fifth Amendment is referred to herein as the &ldquo;<B>Current Agreement</B>&rdquo;;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 35.95pt"><B>WHEREAS</B>,
in connection with the payment rate changes adopted by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (&ldquo;<B>CMS</B>&rdquo;) effective
January 1, 2026, which substantially lowered the rate paid by CMS for skin substitute products to a flat rate of <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">$127.28</FONT>
per square centimeter, the Parties have renegotiated certain terms in the Current Agreement to memorialize the Parties prior agreement
that the updated terms would take effect as of January 1, 2026 to align with the other market changes that occurred effective January
1, 2026; and</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 35.95pt"><B>WHEREAS</B>,
the Parties desire to amend certain provisions of the Current Agreement as set forth in this Sixth Amendment.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 35.95pt"><B>NOW THEREFORE</B>,
in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein and for other good and valuable consideration, the Parties hereby
agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 35.95pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 35.95pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 18pt">1.</TD><TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; padding-right: 0pt"><U>Recitals; Definitions</U>. Each and all of the foregoing recitals are true
and correct and are incorporated herein by reference. All capitalized terms used but not defined in this Sixth Amendment shall have the
meaning set forth in the Current Agreement. Unless otherwise stated below, the effective date of the amendments set forth below is the
Sixth Amendment Effective Date.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 35.95pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 18pt">2.</TD><TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; padding-right: 0pt"><U>Amendment of Exhibit A</U>. Exhibit A to the Current Agreement is hereby deleted
and Exhibit A hereto is substituted therefor. Company shall have no obligation to repurchase such Product under Section 19(c) of the Original
Agreement solely as a result of the execution of this Sixth Amendment.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"></P>

Exhibit B to the Current Agreement is hereby deleted and Exhibit B hereto
is substituted therefor.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 36pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 17.85pt">4.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt"><U>Amendment of Exhibit D</U>. Exhibit D to the Current Agreement is hereby deleted and Exhibit D hereto
is substituted therefor.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 36pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 17.85pt">5.</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt"><U>Removal of Distributor Services</U>. Section 3(g) of the Current Agreement is hereby deleted and
replaced with the language below.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt 0 0.75in; text-align: left">&ldquo;Distributor will have the additional Distributor
obligations as described in Exhibit D. All such obligations will be subject to the terms of this Agreement, including the exhibits hereto.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 36.45pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 17.5pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">6.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt"><U>Treatment of Consigned Product Purchased During the Interim Period</U>. Consistent with the agreement
reached by the Parties in the Fifth Amendment to the Current Agreement, the Parties acknowledge and agree that Distributor currently holds
Consigned Product (as such term is defined in the Fifth Amendment to the Current Agreement) at Distributor&rsquo;s Distribution Center.
As to any Consigned Product where title passed from Company to Distributor on or after January 1, 2026, the purchase price for such Products
shall be the price set forth on the attached Exhibit B. Nothing in this Sixth Amendment shall modify the <FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">[***]
</FONT>per square centimeter pricing for Consigned Product sold by Distributor during the &ldquo;Consignment Order Period&rdquo; (as defined
in the Fifth Amendment to the Current Agreement) from December 17, 2025, through December 31, 2025, as specified in the Fifth Amendment.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 36.45pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 17.5pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">7.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; padding-right: 0pt"><U>Treatment of Remaining Consigned Product</U>. As to any remaining Consigned
Product held by Company as of the date this Sixth Amendment is fully executed, the Parties agree that Distributor shall purchase such
remaining Product from Company at the purchase price for Product as defined and specified Exhibit B of this Sixth Amendment, such that
title and risk of loss for such Product shall transfer to Distributor as of the date this Sixth Amendment is fully executed.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -17.5pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 36.45pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 17.5pt"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">8.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; text-align: left"><U>Entire Agreement</U>. The Current Agreement, as amended by this Sixth Amendment, constitutes the entire
understanding to date of the Parties hereto regarding the subject matter of this Sixth Amendment and supersedes all prior and contemporaneous
oral and written agreements of the Parties thereto with respect to the subject matter of this Sixth Amendment.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -17.5pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">

This Sixth Amendment may be executed in any number of counterparts
with the same effect as if all of the Parties to this Sixth Amendment had signed the same document. All counterparts shall be construed
together and shall constitute one agreement. A signed copy of this Sixth Amendment delivered by facsimile, email, or other means of electronic
transmission (including pdf or any electronic signature complying with the U.S. federal ESIGN Act of 2000, e.g., www.docusign.com)
shall be deemed to have the same legal effect as delivery of an original signed copy of this Sixth Amendment.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 35.95pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 18pt">10.</TD><TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; padding-right: 0pt"><U>Conflicting Provisions</U>. This Sixth Amendment is intended to supplement the
Current Agreement, and the provisions of this Sixth Amendment and the Current Agreement shall be construed to the maximum extent possible
in the manner necessary to avoid any conflict between their respective terms and conditions. In the event of any irreconcilable conflict
between the terms of this Sixth Amendment and the Current Agreement, the terms of this Sixth Amendment shall govern and control.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">EXHIBIT D</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">DISTRIBUTOR OBLIGATIONS</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">Distributor&rsquo;s obligations under this Agreement,
in addition to the other obligations expressly set forth in this Agreement, shall be the following:</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 26.95pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 18pt">1.</TD><TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Insurance Coverage and Claims Processing. </B>Distributor shall manage
patient insurance coverage and eligibility information flow and shall notify healthcare providers of insurance and patient copays. Distributor
shall verify patient insurance coverage and benefits, support submission of insurance claims, follow up on denied or delayed claims, resolve
insurance disputes and appeals, and stay up-to-date with insurance regulations and requirements.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">

Distributor
shall be responsible for handling reports from Accounts of non-delivery of or damage to Products and shall promptly notify Company by
email at </FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">quality@biostemtech.com</FONT> <FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">if
any Accounts report non-delivery or any defect apparent upon visual inspection of the Product packaging.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 26.95pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-right: 0pt; width: 18pt">3.</TD><TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; padding-right: 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Data
                                            Reports</B>. On a monthly basis, Distributor shall submit to Company written reports of Distributor&rsquo;s
                                            activities performed under this Agreement. The report shall be in a format mutually agreed
                                            upon by the Parties. Such data reports will include, at a minimum, a listing of the Account
                                            name and location and volume of Product(s) purchased; inquiries and/or problems reported
                                            by Accounts related to the Product(s); Product quality, safety, and tracing data (including
                                            any Product tracking information required to be maintained by Distributor); and any other
                                            pertinent matters reasonably requested by Company to be included in such reports, for the
                                            relevant period to which the report applies.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>
